examples.en: She put a poster of her favorite idol on the wall.
examples.zh: 她把最喜歡的偶像海報貼在牆上。

examples.en: Many teenagers want to meet their idol in person.
examples.zh: 許多青少年想親眼見到自己的偶像。

examples.en: The villagers once treated the stone idol as a god.
examples.zh: 村民們曾經把那尊石像當作神來崇拜。

examples.en: His ignorance of the rules caused a lot of trouble.
examples.zh: 他對規則一無所知，造成了許多麻煩。

examples.en: Ignorance is not an excuse for breaking the law.
examples.zh: 不知情不能當作違法的藉口。

examples.en: She was shocked by the ignorance of some visitors about local customs.
examples.zh: 有些遊客對當地習俗的無知讓她很震驚。

examples.en: He was ignorant of the new safety rules.
examples.zh: 他不知道新的安全規定。

examples.en: It is rude to call someone ignorant just because they asked a question.
examples.zh: 只因為別人問了問題就說對方無知是很沒禮貌的。

examples.en: Many tourists are ignorant about the history of this town.
examples.zh: 許多遊客對這個小鎮的歷史一無所知。

senses.zh: 舉例說明；為（書籍）畫插圖

examples.en: The teacher drew a chart to illustrate her point.
examples.zh: 老師畫了一張圖表來說明她的論點。

examples.en: My aunt will illustrate a children's book next year.
examples.zh: 我阿姨明年要為一本兒童書畫插圖。

examples.en: Let me illustrate how the machine works with a short video.
examples.zh: 讓我用一段短片來說明這台機器的運作方式。

examples.en: The book has a colorful illustration on every page.
examples.zh: 這本書每一頁都有彩色插圖。

examples.en: Here is an illustration of how to fold the paper.
examples.zh: 這是一個說明如何摺紙的圖例。

examples.en: Her story is a good illustration of hard work paying off.
examples.zh: 她的故事正好說明了努力會有回報。

examples.en: Many young children have an imaginary friend.
examples.zh: 許多小孩都有一個想像出來的朋友。

examples.en: The writer drew an imaginary map of the island.
examples.zh: 作者畫了一張虛構的島嶼地圖。

examples.en: The danger in the story is only imaginary.
examples.zh: 故事中的危險只是想像出來的。

senses.zh: 富有想像力的；創意十足的

examples.en: She is an imaginative child who loves making up stories.
examples.zh: 她是個富有想像力的孩子，喜歡編故事。

examples.en: The teacher praised his imaginative use of color in the painting.
examples.zh: 老師稱讚他在畫中對色彩的運用很有創意。

examples.en: We need an imaginative plan to attract more customers.
examples.zh: 我們需要一個有創意的計畫來吸引更多顧客。

examples.en: The parrot can imitate the sound of a phone.
examples.zh: 這隻鸚鵡會模仿電話的聲音。

examples.en: Young children often imitate the adults around them.
examples.zh: 小孩常常模仿身邊的大人。

examples.en: She can imitate her teacher's voice very well.
examples.zh: 她能把老師的聲音模仿得很像。

examples.en: Children learn language partly through imitation of adult speech.
examples.zh: 孩子有一部分是透過模仿成人的言語來學習語言的。

examples.en: This bag is a cheap imitation of a famous designer's handbag.
examples.zh: 這個包包是某位知名設計師手提包的廉價仿製品。

examples.en: His imitation of the singer made everyone laugh.
examples.zh: 他模仿那位歌手的表演讓大家都笑了。

examples.en: Her grandfather was an immigrant from Italy.
examples.zh: 她的祖父是來自義大利的移民。

examples.en: Many immigrants open small restaurants in the city.
examples.zh: 許多移民在這座城市開設小餐館。

examples.en: The school offers free language classes for immigrant families.
examples.zh: 學校為移民家庭提供免費的語言課程。

examples.en: Immigration to the city has increased in recent years.
examples.zh: 近年來移入這座城市的人口增加了。

examples.en: Please show your passport at the immigration desk.
examples.zh: 請在入境櫃檯出示你的護照。

examples.en: The government is changing its immigration rules next month.
examples.zh: 政府下個月將修改移民規定。

examples.en: The new policy had a big impact on small shops.
examples.zh: 這項新政策對小商店影響很大。

examples.en: The car's front was damaged by the impact.
examples.zh: 汽車的車頭在撞擊中受損了。

examples.en: Social media has a strong impact on teenagers.
examples.zh: 社群媒體對青少年有很大的影響。

examples.en: Bad weather may impact our travel plans.
examples.zh: 壞天氣可能會影響我們的旅遊計畫。

examples.en: Rising food prices will impact many families with limited incomes.
examples.zh: 食品價格上漲將對許多收入有限的家庭造成影響。

examples.en: The new rule will not impact students in the first grade.
examples.zh: 這項新規定不會影響一年級的學生。

examples.en: Are you implying that I made a mistake?
examples.zh: 你是在暗示我犯了錯嗎？

examples.en: His silence seemed to imply that he disagreed.
examples.zh: 他的沉默似乎意味著他不同意。

examples.en: A high price does not always imply good quality.
examples.zh: 價格高不一定代表品質好。

examples.en: Parents should not impose their wishes on their children.
examples.zh: 父母不該把自己的願望強加在孩子身上。

examples.en: The city will impose a new tax on plastic bags.
examples.zh: 市政府將對塑膠袋課徵新的稅。

examples.en: The school decided to impose a limit on phone use.
examples.zh: 學校決定對手機的使用實施限制。

examples.en: She made a good impression on her new boss.
examples.zh: 她給新老闆留下了好印象。

examples.en: My first impression of the town was very positive.
examples.zh: 我對這個小鎮的第一印象非常好。

examples.en: The shoe left a clear impression in the soft mud.
examples.zh: 鞋子在軟泥上留下了清楚的壓痕。

examples.en: The school reported the incident to the police.
examples.zh: 學校將這起事件通報了警方。

examples.en: There was a small incident at the front gate this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上大門口發生了一件小事故。

examples.en: The manager apologized for the incident at the restaurant.
examples.zh: 經理為餐廳裡發生的事件道歉。

examples.en: The view from the top of the mountain was incredible.
examples.zh: 從山頂望出去的景色美得令人難以置信。

examples.en: It is incredible that she finished the test in ten minutes.
examples.zh: 她十分鐘就寫完考卷，真是不可思議。

examples.en: We had an incredible meal at the new restaurant.
examples.zh: 我們在那家新餐廳吃了一頓超棒的餐點。

examples.en: There is no indication that the weather will improve soon.
examples.zh: 沒有跡象顯示天氣很快就會好轉。

examples.en: A red light is an indication that the battery is low.
examples.zh: 紅燈表示電池電量不足。

examples.en: She gave no indication of being unhappy with the plan.
examples.zh: 她完全沒有表現出對這個計畫不滿的跡象。

examples.en: The nurse carefully held the infant in her arms.
examples.zh: 護理師小心地把嬰兒抱在懷裡。

examples.en: This seat is designed for infants under one year old.
examples.zh: 這個座椅是為一歲以下的嬰兒設計的。

examples.en: The infant fell asleep as soon as the music started.
examples.zh: 音樂一響起，嬰兒就睡著了。

examples.en: The doctor gave him medicine to treat the ear infection.
examples.zh: 醫生開藥給他治療耳朵感染。

examples.en: Washing your hands before meals helps prevent infection.
examples.zh: 飯前洗手有助於預防感染。

examples.en: The infection spread quickly through the school.
examples.zh: 這種傳染病在學校裡迅速擴散。

examples.en: She is one of the most influential teachers in our school.
examples.zh: 她是我們學校最有影響力的老師之一。

examples.en: The book was influential in changing how people eat.
examples.zh: 這本書對改變人們的飲食方式很有影響力。

examples.en: He became an influential voice in the music industry.
examples.zh: 他成為音樂界一位有影響力的人物。

senses.zh: 資訊豐富的；有教育意義的

examples.en: The museum guide gave us a very informative talk.
examples.zh: 博物館導覽員為我們做了一場資訊豐富的講解。

examples.en: I found the website clear and informative.
examples.zh: 我覺得這個網站清楚又資訊豐富。

examples.en: This short video is both fun and informative.
examples.zh: 這支短片既有趣又富有知識性。

examples.en: Flour is the main ingredient in bread.
examples.zh: 麵粉是麵包的主要原料。

examples.en: Please check the ingredients if you have an allergy.
examples.zh: 如果你會過敏，請查看成分。

examples.en: Hard work is an important ingredient of success.
examples.zh: 努力是成功的重要要素。

examples.en: My initial plan was to take the train to Taichung.
examples.zh: 我最初的計畫是搭火車去台中。

examples.en: The initial test results looked very good.
examples.zh: 最初的檢驗結果看起來很好。

examples.en: The initial cost of the project was higher than expected.
examples.zh: 這個專案的初期成本比預期的高。

examples.en: He fell off his bike and injured his knee.
examples.zh: 他從腳踏車上摔下來，傷到了膝蓋。

examples.en: Be careful not to injure yourself with the knife.
examples.zh: 小心，別用刀子弄傷自己。

examples.en: Two players were injured during the basketball game.
examples.zh: 兩名球員在籃球比賽中受了傷。

examples.en: The child's innocence reminded her grandfather of his own childhood.
examples.zh: 這個孩子的天真讓她的祖父想起了自己的童年。

examples.en: The man proved his innocence with a video from that night.
examples.zh: 那名男子用當晚的影片證明了自己的清白。

examples.en: She believed in her brother's innocence from the start.
examples.zh: 她從一開始就相信哥哥是無辜的。

examples.en: The program needs more input before it can start.
examples.zh: 這個程式需要更多輸入資料才能開始執行。

examples.en: We would like your input on the new design.
examples.zh: 我們想聽聽你對新設計的意見。

examples.en: The keyboard is the main input device of the computer.
examples.zh: 鍵盤是電腦主要的輸入裝置。

examples.en: Please input your password and press enter.
examples.zh: 請輸入你的密碼，然後按下 Enter 鍵。

examples.en: She inputs the sales numbers into the system every Friday.
examples.zh: 她每週五都會把銷售數字輸入系統。

examples.en: You need to input your name before you can log in.
examples.zh: 你必須先輸入姓名才能登入。

examples.en: Insert the coin into the slot and press the button.
examples.zh: 把硬幣投入投幣孔，然後按下按鈕。

examples.en: She inserted a photo into the middle of the report.
examples.zh: 她在報告中間插入了一張照片。

examples.en: Please insert the card the right way up.
examples.zh: 請把卡片以正確的方向插入。

examples.en: The painter found inspiration in the mountains.
examples.zh: 那位畫家在群山中找到了靈感。

examples.en: Her teacher was a great inspiration to her.
examples.zh: 她的老師給了她很大的啟發。

examples.en: I need some inspiration for my English essay.
examples.zh: 我的英文作文需要一些靈感。

examples.en: Please install the new software on your laptop.
examples.zh: 請在你的筆記型電腦上安裝新軟體。

examples.en: The workers will install an air conditioner in the classroom.
examples.zh: 工人會在教室裡安裝一台冷氣。

examples.en: It took an hour to install the shelves in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 在廚房裝好架子花了一個小時。

examples.en: Birds fly south in winter by instinct.
examples.zh: 鳥類憑著本能在冬天飛往南方。

examples.en: Her instinct told her that something was wrong.
examples.zh: 她的直覺告訴她有地方不對勁。

examples.en: He has a good instinct for choosing the right words.
examples.zh: 他很有直覺，知道該選哪些用詞。

examples.en: The teacher instructed us to open our books to page ten.
examples.zh: 老師指示我們翻開課本第十頁。

examples.en: The manager instructed the staff to close the shop early.
examples.zh: 經理指示店員提早打烊。

examples.en: She instructs beginners in swimming at the community center.
examples.zh: 她在社區活動中心教初學者游泳。

examples.en: Our swimming instructor is very patient with beginners.
examples.zh: 我們的游泳教練對初學者非常有耐心。

examples.en: The instructor showed us how to use the machine.
examples.zh: 指導員示範給我們看如何使用這台機器。

examples.en: She works as a yoga instructor at a gym.
examples.zh: 她在一間健身房擔任瑜伽老師。

examples.en: I did not mean to insult you with my joke.
examples.zh: 我開那個玩笑並不是要冒犯你。

examples.en: It is impolite to insult people because of their accent.
examples.zh: 因為別人的口音而侮辱他們是不禮貌的。

examples.en: The customer felt insulted by the waiter's tone.
examples.zh: 那位顧客覺得服務生的語氣讓他受到了冒犯。

examples.en: He took the comment as an insult.
examples.zh: 他把那句評論當成一種侮辱。

examples.en: Calling her lazy was an insult to her hard work.
examples.zh: 說她懶惰是對她努力工作的侮辱。

examples.en: The teacher did not allow insults in the classroom.
examples.zh: 老師不允許在教室裡出現侮辱他人的言語。

examples.en: We bought travel insurance before our trip to Japan.
examples.zh: 我們在去日本旅行前買了旅遊保險。

examples.en: Her health insurance covers most of the hospital bill.
examples.zh: 她的健康保險涵蓋了大部分的醫藥費。

examples.en: Car insurance costs more for new drivers.
examples.zh: 新手駕駛的汽車保險費比較高。

examples.en: Reading is a good way to build intellectual skills.
examples.zh: 閱讀是培養智力技能的好方法。

examples.en: The school offers many intellectual activities for gifted students.
examples.zh: 學校為資優學生提供許多知性活動。

examples.en: He enjoys long, intellectual talks about history.
examples.zh: 他喜歡進行關於歷史的深度知性談話。

examples.en: The professor is a well-known intellectual in our country.
examples.zh: 那位教授是我們國內知名的知識分子。

examples.en: Many intellectuals joined the discussion about education.
examples.zh: 許多知識分子加入了關於教育的討論。

examples.en: The cafe was a popular meeting place for local intellectuals.
examples.zh: 那間咖啡館是當地知識分子很常聚會的地方。

examples.en: The test measures a child's intelligence through various problem-solving tasks.
examples.zh: 這項測驗透過各種解決問題的任務來衡量孩子的智力。

examples.en: Dogs are known for their intelligence and loyalty.
examples.zh: 狗以聰明和忠誠聞名。

examples.en: The company is using artificial intelligence to answer questions.
examples.zh: 這家公司正使用人工智慧來回答問題。

examples.en: I intend to study abroad after high school.
examples.zh: 我打算高中畢業後出國讀書。

examples.en: We intend to leave early to avoid the traffic.
examples.zh: 我們打算早點出發，以避開車潮。

examples.en: The gift was intended for my sister.
examples.zh: 這份禮物是要給我妹妹的。

examples.en: The intense heat made it hard to walk outside.
examples.zh: 酷熱讓人很難在外面走路。

examples.en: There was intense competition for the last place on the team.
examples.zh: 球隊最後一個名額的競爭相當激烈。

examples.en: She felt intense pressure before the final exam.
examples.zh: 期末考前，她感受到強烈的壓力。

examples.en: She took an intensive English course this summer.
examples.zh: 她今年暑假上了一門密集的英語課程。

examples.en: The patient was moved to intensive care last night.
examples.zh: 那位病人昨晚被轉到加護病房。

examples.en: The team did intensive training before the big match.
examples.zh: 球隊在大賽前進行了密集訓練。

examples.en: I had no intention of hurting your feelings.
examples.zh: 我並沒有要傷害你感情的意思。

examples.en: Her intention is to open a small bakery next year.
examples.zh: 她打算明年開一家小烘焙坊。

examples.en: He apologized and said it was not his intention to be rude.
examples.zh: 他道了歉，並說自己無意失禮。

examples.en: Please do not interfere in other people's private matters.
examples.zh: 請不要干涉別人的私事。

examples.en: Loud noise from the street can interfere with your sleep.
examples.zh: 街上的吵雜聲可能會干擾你的睡眠。

examples.en: Heavy rain interfered with the signal of the TV.
examples.zh: 大雨干擾了電視的訊號。

examples.en: I am taking an intermediate English class this semester.
examples.zh: 我這學期在上中級英語課。

examples.en: The course is for intermediate players who know the basic rules.
examples.zh: 這門課是為已經懂基本規則的中階球員開設的。

examples.en: We made an intermediate stop in Taipei before reaching Kaohsiung.
examples.zh: 我們在抵達高雄之前，中途在台北停留了一次。

examples.en: She interpreted the speech for the foreign guests.
examples.zh: 她為外國賓客口譯那場演講。

examples.en: People may interpret this poem in different ways.
examples.zh: 人們可能會用不同的方式來解讀這首詩。

examples.en: It is hard to interpret the results without more data.
examples.zh: 沒有更多資料，很難解讀這些結果。

examples.en: They have been intimate friends since elementary school.
examples.zh: 他們從小學起就是親密的朋友。

examples.en: We held an intimate dinner for close family members.
examples.zh: 我們為親近的家人舉辦了一場小型的私人晚宴。

examples.en: The cafe has an intimate atmosphere with soft lights.
examples.zh: 這間咖啡館有柔和的燈光，氣氛溫馨親密。

examples.en: Ants invaded our kitchen after the rain.
examples.zh: 下雨之後，螞蟻入侵了我們的廚房。

examples.en: The army invaded the neighboring country in 1939.
examples.zh: 那支軍隊在一九三九年入侵了鄰國。

examples.en: Please do not invade other people's privacy online.
examples.zh: 請不要在網路上侵犯他人的隱私。

examples.en: The invention of the telephone changed how people talk.
examples.zh: 電話的發明改變了人們交談的方式。

examples.en: This clever invention can clean the floor by itself.
examples.zh: 這個巧妙的發明可以自己清掃地板。

examples.en: Necessity is the mother of invention.
examples.zh: 需要是發明之母。

examples.en: She decided to invest her savings in a small business.
examples.zh: 她決定把積蓄投資在一家小型企業上。

examples.en: Our school will invest in new computers next year.
examples.zh: 我們學校明年將投資添購新電腦。

examples.en: It is wise to invest time in learning a new skill.
examples.zh: 投入時間學習新技能是明智的。

examples.en: The job involves a lot of travel.
examples.zh: 這份工作需要經常出差。

examples.en: Please involve the whole class in the project.
examples.zh: 請讓全班一起參與這個專案。

examples.en: Three students were involved in the school play.
examples.zh: 有三位學生參與了學校的話劇演出。

examples.en: Doctors isolate patients with contagious infections to protect other people.
examples.zh: 為了保護其他人，醫生會隔離患有傳染病的病人。

examples.en: Bad weather isolated the village for three days.
examples.zh: 惡劣的天氣使這個村莊與外界隔絕了三天。

examples.en: Scientists isolated the cause of the problem.
examples.zh: 科學家找出了問題的成因。
